intervention_execution.claim: Native BF16 efficient SDPA ran with original FP32 projected QKV and masks.

intended_intermediate.claim: Attention median fell from116.6331 to39.7222ms; real-loss full-model gradients remain unmeasured.

observable_output.claim: Dropout-off output relative L2 .3486percent and worst QKV gradient .9559percent; same-route dropout replay exact.

task_utility.claim: End-to-end update gain and convergence are unknown. FP32 partitioned Graph32 gain5.2089percent is a separate comparison.

primary_explanation.statement: Unchanged FP32 compilation/PAD routes do not reduce this observed dense attention workload enough; BF16 changes its arithmetic path.

alternative_explanations.statement: Full-model projections/FFN/optimizer, loss-gradient sensitivity or extra cast traffic could erase isolated attention gains.

discriminating_measurement.uncertainty: Does the real-loss full-update preserve useful numerical agreement and reduce elapsed time?
discriminating_measurement.measurement: Matched micro16/logical128 FP32 versus attention-only BF16: actual loss, raw gradients, Adam deltas, four-update trajectory; fresh-process exact BF16 recovery and full-value train trace; balanced AB/BA timing.
discriminating_measurement.primary_outcome: Finite numerics within fixed gates, exact same-route recovery/rollback, faster complete update.
discriminating_measurement.alternative_outcome: Reject on numerical/recovery/trace failure; report no gain without changing thresholds.

forbidden_rescue_variants: Relax correctness thresholds after observing results
Treat isolated attention gain as whole-training gain

positive_carryovers.mechanism: BF16 efficient SDPA reduces measured attention work while FP32 master projection/gradient policy remains available.
positive_carryovers.transport_constraint: First layer/document Gaussian cotangent does not transport to real full-update loss without native tests.

selected_candidate.title: Optional attention-only BF16 real-loss update
selected_candidate.causal_difference: Replace all eight attention calls per microbatch with BF16 SDPA; retain FP32 projection/residual/FFN/head/loss/Adam and original token/mask/sample schedule.
selected_candidate.discriminating_measurement: Real-loss gradients and Adam deltas plus complete-update time; private paired full-value train trace.
selected_candidate.success_gate: Numerical gates, four-update finite trajectory, exact recovery/rollback, complete trace replay and positive matched median update gain.
selected_candidate.kill_condition: Any integrity/kernel/recovery/trace/numerical failure; no positive speed gain => no admission.
selected_candidate.authorization_boundary: Collaborator isolated diagnostic only; no formal migration or owner framework/model/GPU execution.

trace_adequacy.selection_rule: Mechanism first16 train rows; new predeclared first2 train rows for paired complete-value trace.
trace_adequacy.target_boundary: Train labels only consumed by loss after logits; no validation/test data; original latest checkpoint is not best-validation.

limitations: Changed precision is approximate; no cross-precision bitwise trajectory/RNG equality.
Short four-update trajectory is a screening test, not convergence certification.
BF16+Graph and formal training remain disabled pending a separate native admission.
